clue.text: Ringleader helps attacks

parts.note: the leader, or first letter, of the word Ring
aids means helps, as a verb

explanation.surface: The head of a gang assists in a series of assaults.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ringleader' reads as a gang boss, but it is split as the leading letter of 'Ring'.
explanation.definitionFit: Raids are sudden attacks, a plain synonym used here as a plural noun.

clue.text: Stark gold trees uprooted

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: trees that are uprooted are torn up and disturbed, so the letters of trees get rearranged

explanation.surface: A bleak scene of golden trees ripped from the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Stark and austere are synonyms, both meaning severely plain and bare.

clue.text: It's a fact that mother's holding you in France

indicators.note: the mother word is said to hold the other, so it goes round it

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother
tu is the French word for you

explanation.surface: Someone states as fact that their mother is keeping you in France.
explanation.definitionFit: A datum is a single piece of information or given fact, as in the plural data.

clue.text: Notice member of the Liberal Party's off-the-cuff remark

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
Lib is short for a Liberal

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician makes an unscripted comment.
explanation.definitionFit: An improvised remark made without preparation is an ad lib, Latin for 'at pleasure'.

clue.text: Not unhappy with coloured whisky bottled

indicators.note: the whisky is bottled up inside the coloured word, as a drink inside a bottle

parts.note: dyed means coloured
rye is a type of whisky

explanation.surface: Someone content with a tinted whisky in a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: Being without tears means not weeping, hence not unhappy, a loose but fair sense.

clue.text: Yours truly's given time to make picture

parts.note: yours truly means me, so yours truly is gives I'M
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: The writer is allowed time to paint a picture.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or visual representation, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Rips off back-row pieces

definitions.meaning: to rook someone is to swindle or cheat them
the castles in chess start in the corners of the back row

explanation.surface: A cheat steals chessmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Rook means to swindle, and rooks are the chess pieces on the back row's corners.

clue.text: Last of oil in reservoir to sink heavily

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the reservoir word

parts.note: a sump is a reservoir of oil in an engine

indicators.note: only the final letter of oil is taken

explanation.surface: An engine's oil sump drains and the car sinks low.
explanation.definitionFit: To slump is to fall or collapse heavily, as a body slumps into a chair.

clue.text: Rushes to get plants

definitions.meaning: rushes are tall grasslike waterside plants, a close kin

explanation.surface: Someone hurries off to buy plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Rushes and reeds are both tall marsh plants, often treated as near synonyms.

clue.text: Start sculpting stone

indicators.note: sculpting reshapes material, so the letters of stone are reshaped

explanation.surface: Beginning to carve a block of stone.
explanation.definitionFit: An onset is the start or beginning of something, especially an illness.

clue.text: Expose unprofessional animal on the radio

indicators.note: something heard over the radio is only heard, so the sound counts, not the spelling

parts.note: lay means amateur, not of a profession; a bear is an animal

explanation.surface: An amateur zoo creature appears in a broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: LAY BEAR sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To uncover or reveal fully is to lay something bare, an idiom for expose.

clue.text: Support mother but don't say anything about it

parts.note: to keep someone is to support them financially
mum is a mother

explanation.surface: Provide for your mother, but stay quiet about doing so.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep mum is an idiom meaning stay silent and reveal nothing.

clue.text: Surrender profit

explanation.surface: Give up the gains.
explanation.definitionFit: Yield means to give way, and also the return or income produced by an investment.

clue.text: Be under the weather, not above

parts.note: feeling under the weather means feeling low or unwell

explanation.surface: Advice to feel poorly rather than on top of the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Something beneath is the opposite of above, a direct antonym-based phrase.

clue.text: South Pacific islands seen from a canoe I upset

indicators.note: a canoe upset is overturned, so its letters, with I, are tipped into a new order

explanation.surface: Pacific islands spotted from a capsized canoe.
explanation.definitionFit: Oceania is the region taking in the islands of the central and South Pacific.

clue.text: Espouse a case raised on junction

indicators.note: in a down-reading sense the word is lifted, so it is read backwards

parts.note: a pod is a seed case
T is a T-junction, a road meeting shaped like the letter

explanation.surface: Someone supports placing a raised case at a road junction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns POD into DOP; 'on' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To espouse a cause is to take it up or embrace it, as one may adopt a policy.

clue.text: Head of government destroys empire, right?

indicators.note: destroying the empire breaks its letters apart and they reform

explanation.surface: A national leader brings down an empire, is that correct?
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroys' rearranges EMPIRE into PREMIE, and R ends it.
explanation.definitionFit: A premier is a prime minister, the head of a government.

clue.text: Well-presented nautical film

definitions.meaning: a film of oil on the sea

explanation.surface: A polished seafaring movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Slick means smooth and polished, and an oil slick is a thin layer floating on sea water.

clue.text: Effort nicely back in, opening score

indicators.note: back says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the letters sit inside the run of words effort nicely

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A musician praises the work in the opening passage.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft gave the hidden step no indicator; 'in' is the word that signals it, so it is added.
explanation.definitionFit: An intro is the opening section of a piece of music, its introduction.

clue.text: Boy of Cairo just odd, to a great extent

indicators.note: only the odd-placed letters of the run of words are taken

explanation.surface: A boy from Cairo who is simply very strange.
explanation.definitionFit: By far means by a large margin, a phrase of degree.

clue.text: Material for sugar partner, we hear

indicators.note: says the word is judged by its sound when spoken

parts.note: Lyle partners Tate in Tate & Lyle, the British sugar company

explanation.surface: Fabric chosen for one's sugar partner.
explanation.walkthrough: Tate & Lyle is a well-known British sugar refiner.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisle is a fine, strong cotton thread used for stockings and gloves.

clue.text: Fish had a nasty odour

definitions.meaning: a past tense of smell, as in the stink came off it

explanation.surface: The fish stank.
explanation.definitionFit: A smelt is a small fish, and smelt is also the past tense of smell.

clue.text: Innocently hold a live broadcast in New York

indicators.note: the New York letters hold the other part between them
broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of a live are scattered

explanation.surface: Holding a live broadcast in New York without knowing better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hold' is the container signal here, while 'in' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting naively means acting without experience or guile, that is innocently.

clue.text: Stupid, that is, to hug granny

indicators.note: the first part hugs or wraps round the second

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
nan is a grandmother

explanation.surface: It's silly, that is, to embrace your grandmother.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane means silly and pointless, a synonym of stupid.

clue.text: Conservative more slim, less besmirched

parts.note: leaner means slimmer

explanation.surface: A Tory who is thinner and less tainted by scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: Besmirched means dirtied, so less besmirched is a comparative of dirt-free.

clue.text: A girl returns to find another

indicators.note: returns means the pair of pieces goes back, reading in the opposite direction

parts.note: Tina is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl comes back to locate a different girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' reads A TINA backwards; 'another' is another girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Anita is a girl's name, so it is a further example of a female name after the one in the clue.

clue.text: Second side creating vapour

parts.note: a team is a side in sport

explanation.surface: A reserve team producing hot air.
explanation.definitionFit: Steam is water vapour, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Cautious boy on railway

parts.note: Lee is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A wary boy is standing on the railway.
explanation.definitionFit: Leery means wary or suspicious, a synonym of cautious.
